name: OpenAI Image API n8n Agents 🤖 🖼️
description_md:
## What You Get

- A complete n8n automation bundle to generate and edit high-quality images using OpenAI's new Image API (gpt-image-1, dall-e-3, and dall-e-2 supported).

- 
Image Creation Subflow: Just plug in a prompt, model, and settings to create stunning visuals—automatically saved to your Google Drive.

- 
Image Editing Subflow: Modify existing images with detailed prompts (e.g., “replace ball with bone”) and push the results straight to the cloud.

- 
Google Sheets Logging Subflow: Every prompt, model, and output link is stored automatically in a Google Sheet—perfect for audits or inspiration libraries.

- 
Main AI Orchestrator Flow: A smart router that takes natural language prompts and sends them to the right tool (create/edit) based on the task.

- All JSON files for the workflows are included so you can import, modify, and scale instantly.

- No extra setup needed—includes pre-mapped credentials and folder logic for Google Drive workflows.

❤️ My team and I put serious time into crafting this pack to make your AI journey smoother—if it helps, we'd really appreciate your support by grabbing it and sharing it with others.
